titulo: Do Not Think That I Am Gone
poema:
If one day you visit my grave, do not weep; just imagine that I am sleeping.
I will visit you at dawn, I will hold you with the wind, I will kiss you with the rain, and I will sing for you in silence.
Never think that I am gone, because then... only then will I truly be dead.

Mother, since you left, not a day has gone by without you coming to visit my mind, not a day has gone by that I stop remembering you.
After you left, I realized that no love compares to yours, and that I will never find another person in this world who loves me as much.
You left me a lifetime of memories filled with love that will accompany me forever.
I only ask God that you rest in peace up in heaven, because here on Earth I remember you and never forget you.

titulo: Mother, I Love You and Will Never Forget You
poema:
Today is a very sad day for me, because I remember my Mother, whom God took far away from here.
Today more than ever I love her and miss her, and I cannot forget her, no matter how much time passes, no matter how many years go by.
And all that remains is for me to come once more to this lonely, sad, and abandoned place, to bring my Mother a flower as a gift.
And with this flower, ask the Lord to care for her and protect her wherever He has her, and just in case—in case she can hear me—tell her very quietly at her grave: that I love her very much and that I haven't forgotten her.

You can weep that she has gone or smile because she has lived
You can close your eyes and pray that she will come back or you can open your eyes and see all that she has left
Your heart can be empty because you cannot see her or it can be full of the love that you shared
You can cry, close your mind, feel the emptiness, and turn your back, or you can do what she would want: smile, open your eyes, love, and move forward.

I have not died, I only left ahead, and I do not want you to remember me with tears like one who has no hope.
I have not died; even if my body is not here, my presence will be felt.
I will be the silence of our home that we shared so much, I will be the breeze that kisses your faces, I will be a sweet memory that visits your mind, I will be a beautiful page of your story.
Forgive me everyone, I simply took one of the earlier trains and forgot to tell you....
I have not died, I only left ahead.

They say that when you have someone you love in heaven, you have a little piece of heaven in your home forever.
I have you, Mother, in heaven, but a part of you lives with me; your memory remains in my home and is present in my life.
Everything around me bears the imprint of your devotion, your warmth, and your infinite love.
Even though you left, you are still with me, Mother, right here in my heart.

Mother, you are gone, but the trace left by your existence has been a gift to others.
Your love, your kindness, and your warmth have allowed the work you planted to grow and bloom.
You made good use of the time God gave you, giving us life and striving so that your family lacked nothing.
We will always remember you with pride, and you will remain within our hearts, even as you rest peacefully up in heaven.

titulo: Mother, I Am Still With You
poema:
Mother, I am with you through time and despite death.
You live in my mind when I think of you, and in my heart every time it beats.
Though it hurts, I accept your departure and only ask God to allow you to rest in peace for all eternity.
Mother, I am still with you.

Mother, even though you are gone, even though I know it is inevitable, you remain in my memory.
Your presence stays with me, and sometimes I feel like you protect me as if you were my guardian angel.
You loved me so much that I know, if it were possible, you would escape heaven just to be by my side.
I loved you too, though only now, long after, do I truly understand how much I still love you, how much I need you, how much I miss you, and how sorry I am...
How sorry I am for not having told you while you were alive, when you would have given anything for an "I love you."

Just as I loved you once, I still love you today.
In the exact same way I promised you, I still treasure your memory.
And though life willed for you to leave, it could not tear you away or erase you from my mind.
Today you continue to live inside me, accompanying me in my joys and in my sad moments, just as you always did, as it ought to be, because... I still love you.

If you want to make someone you love dearly happy, tell them today, in life, my friend, in life.
If you wish to give a flower, do not wait until they die; send it today with love, in life, my friend, in life.
If you wish to say "I love you" to the people you care about, to a friend near or far, tell them now, in life, my friend, in life.
Do not wait for people to die to love them and make them feel your affection, in life, my friend, in life.
Never visit graveyards nor fill graves with flowers; fill hearts with love, in life, my friend, in life.

Tomorrow they will dress me in ashes at dawn,
they will fill my mouth with flowers.
I will learn to sleep
in the memory of a wall,
in the breath of a dreaming animal.

I will always remember you, even as years pass by, even if other people enter my life; you will remain in my heart, guiding me, accompanying me, and celebrating my victories, which will also be yours.

A Mother's LOVE is the greatest, most sincere, most delicate, and the only eternal love in life.
The greatest, because it is never forgotten.
The most sincere, because it is the only true love.
The most delicate, because it gets scratched and hurt.
The only eternal love, because it never fades.

titulo: The Mother, a Being Created by God
poema:
God said:
"I will create a being who loves with all her soul and sacrifices everything.
Who stays up at night, who goes hungry and thirsty if necessary, who smiles from the soul.
Who teaches values and always gives her best.
I will name her: MOM".

Toward the gallows walked a man, his hands tightly bound,
guarded by well-armed sentinels watching intently.
The culprit's brow was bowed down, his tragic shoulders slumped.
In his slow steps that man revealed an infinite weariness,
and from his eyes, filled with sadness, two tears rolled down.

He is a wretch! A coward!
Following him, the crowd shouted:
Bloodthirsty! Murderer! Death! Death!
A man full of disgrace and infamy!
To the scaffold! To the scaffold!
Thus roaring at the prisoner, the crowd berated him...
All was hatred and horror, all contempt for the criminal of depraved life.
And just as the curse resonated loudest and anger burst forth,
a sublime cry echoed, freezing the words on their lips:
It is my son! It is my son! a mother's voice was heard.
He is the fruit of love from my womb, and though a murderer and all, he is my son!

And from among the stunned crowd, a humble woman made her way,
with a wrinkled face and white hair.
And without seeing, without hearing, in wild emotion, she threw her arms around the murderer.
And amidst sob-filled tenderness, she washed him with her tears.

And amidst sob-filled tenderness, she covered her face and said:
Why do you wish it so, Lord!
That cruel fate should so pierce the human heart.
It is this man! My own son! And you, wretched souls!
Oh my God! Why do you wish it so?
For when a child dies, with him dies
all love and tenderness, sweetness and goodness.

There is only one great love, a sublime love,
that stills the storms, that illuminates the path of destiny:
It is a mother's love that saves us!

Mom, even though you always sleep, your sweet eyes can see me.
From heaven, never stop watching over me.
